name: Speed Option w/ Reverse Constraint
formation: Gun Spread Right Slot, TE Right

summary.motive: Attack the perimeter with a speed option while a reverse-constraint motion freezes the backside from pursuing.
summary.whyItWorks: The reverse motion makes backside pursuit hesitate at the snap, so the only defenders who can make the play are the ones the option geometry already beats.
summary.failureMode: The backside end plays the mesh instead of the motion, keeping his contain shoulder free to squeeze the arc from behind.

beats.title: 1. Reverse Motion Constraint
beats.text: The slot sprints leftward selling a reverse receipt. The backside end and Will freeze on it while the actual option geometry develops to the right.

beats.title: 2. The Arc Against Frozen Pursuit
beats.text: The quarterback arcs off the fake exchange with half the defense still keyed left. The Mike is already a full recovery behind the play.

beats.title: 3. Pitch on the Force Trigger
beats.text: The force corner triggers upfield hunting the quarterback — the exact cue that makes him pitchable — and the stalk removes his recovery angle.

beats.title: 4. Perimeter Finish
beats.text: The pitch is taken at full speed around displaced force while the backside remains frozen by a reverse threat that never existed.

relations.tell: Motion moves away from the run direction at full sprint — normal speed-option motions always move toward the play.
